en: A black-and-white vintage postcard showing a view down a wide pathway flanked by trees and large institutional buildings on either side, leading toward a prominent building with a dome in the background. The setting is calm and orderly, resembling a hospital complex. At the top, clear printed text reads: 'Graz. Landeskrankenhaus (Hauptstraße).' The style of the buildings and the photographic tone suggest an early 20th-century origin.
